selector.rationale: The presence of painful lower-extremity nodules, cutaneous lesion biopsy showing 'Ghost cells'—fat necrosis with saponification, and elevated serum lipase >20,000 U/L strongly support Pancreatic panniculitis. The connection between pancreatic duct and adjacent vasculature, along with multiple cystic lesions within the pancreatic head, also points towards a pancreatic pathology, making Pancreatic cancer a close runner-up.
